CapabilityValue.description:
What a Provider declares it can do for a key (spec 05 `ProviderInstance`).

Rule: SB-6.

MemoryDomainId.description:
Identifies a memory domain a [`SampleBlock`](crate::stream::SampleBlock) lives in.

Rule: SC-6 (`02-stream-contract.md`), X7.

local.description: Node-local ordinal, allocated by the owning registry.

Namespace.description:
A dotted sequence of [`Ident`]s owned by a Vocabulary or a Module,
matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*)*$`.

Rule: SB-1.

NodeId.description:
A node in the (future) multi-host deployment. `LOCAL` is the only legal value in v4.0.

Rule: X7 (`00-overview.md`); it qualifies every id of TM-11, SC-6, SB-3 and MA-19.

anyOf.description: A signed 64-bit integer, written as an exact decimal by the canonicaliser (OV-15).

A finite float; a non-finite one is refused rather than written as `null`,
because a `Value` reaches the sealed Manifest through `prepare.effective`,
the coercion records and the action log (OV-15, X9).
A list of scalars; nesting deeper is refused (SB-4).
A map of scalars; nesting deeper is refused (SB-4).

Value.description:
A scalar, or a list or map of scalars nested at most one level.

A Spec is data, not a document tree: one level is what a structured parameter
such as a capture request needs, and more invites the schema-inside-a-schema
that Vision §9 rejects.

Rule: SB-4.

description:
What an Executor declares. Admission reads `kind`, `memory_domains` and
`impl_kinds`; everything else is opaque (MA-18).

impl_kinds.description: The implementation kinds it can load (MA-39).

kind.description: The Executor kind a component's `requires.executor_kind` names (MA-39).

memory_domains.description: The memory domains it can reach (MA-39).
